column1: # Which gates and slices a changed path can affect (#119; tools/affected.py reads this, `make check-affected`).
# Columns, tab-separated: path glob | gates | golden areas | shot areas.  The FIRST row that matches a path wins, so
# the specific rows come before the general ones.  A path that matches no row runs everything (fail safe).
#   gates   build (data, kernel, wasm, packages, page and selftest), page (the lab bundle and the page assembled,
#           without the kernel), selftest, lab (web/lab tsc and npm test), lint; "-" none; "all" every gate
#   areas   "-" none; "all" the whole set; else the areas of tools/areas.tsv (comma-separated)
